data.title: Banking demo - service overview
data.description: Per-service throughput, p95 latency and error rate from OTel-native traces (traces-*.otel-*), deployment.environment banking-demo. Managed as code: changes made in the UI are overwritten on terraform apply.

config.content:
## Banking demo - service overview
Service entry transactions (`processor.event: transaction`) for every service in `deployment.environment: banking-demo`. New services (for example `fx-rates`) appear automatically.

data_source.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS transactions = COUNT(*)
FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(transaction.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0, 1)

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)), total = COUNT(*) | EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(100.0 * failures / total, 2) | KEEP error_rate_pct

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS transactions = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service.name

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(transaction.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0 BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service.name

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)), total = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), service.name | EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(100.0 * failures / total, 2) | KEEP bucket, service.name, error_rate_pct

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND deployment.environment == "banking-demo" | STATS transactions = COUNT(*), p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(transaction.duration.us, 95) / 1000.0, 1), failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)) BY service.name | EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(100.0 * failures / transactions, 2) | KEEP service.name, transactions, p95_ms, error_rate_pct | SORT service.name
